name: soundcloud-tempo-control
description: SoundCloud tempo userscript and its download website

scripts.build: npm run build:script && astro build --root site
scripts.dev: npm run build:script && astro dev --root site --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.test:audio-candidate: node --test tests/rate-clock.test.mjs tests/bounded-source.test.mjs tests/pcm-window.test.mjs tests/natural-output.test.mjs tests/buffered-transport.test.mjs tests/media-facade.test.mjs tests/playback-gate.test.mjs tests/playback-owner.test.mjs tests/source-binding.test.mjs tests/preserve-output.test.mjs tests/preserve-worklet.test.mjs tests/audio-dependencies.test.mjs tests/buffered-playback.test.cjs tests/output-level.test.cjs tests/wasm-buffered-route.test.cjs tests/wasm-lifecycle.test.cjs tests/audio-bundle.test.cjs tests/tempo-editor-playback.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:script && node --check dist/soundcloud-tempo-control.user.js && node tests/verify-clean-build.cjs && node tests/verify-dependency.cjs && node tests/verify-buffered-cursor.cjs && npm run test:unit
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts server tests/*.cjs tests/*.mjs site/src site/astro.config.mjs *.json *.md docs/*.md *.code-workspace .github/workflows/*.yml
